gloss: same kind; same species; of the same type

definitions.gloss: same kind; same type; of the same species
definitions.explanation: Belonging to the same category or type. Used in biology to mean 'the same species,' in law and business for 'the same kind of offense / product / case,' and in everyday speech for 'the same type' generally.

examples.japanese: {同種|どうしゅ}の{動物|どうぶつ}。
{過去|かこ}にも{同種|どうしゅ}の{事件|じけん}があった。
examples.english: There have been similar cases in the past.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{同種|どうしゅ}の{他|た}の{製品|せいひん}より{価格|かかく}が{安|やす}い。
examples.english: This product is cheaper than other products of the same kind.

examples.japanese: {同種|どうしゅ}の{犯罪|はんざい}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した{場合|ばあい}、より{重|おも}い{刑罰|けいばつ}が{科|か}される。
examples.english: If the same type of crime is repeated, a heavier penalty is imposed.

notes:
Compound of {同|どう} ('same') and {種|しゅ} ('kind; species'). Contrasted with {異種|いしゅ} ('different kind; different species'). Typically followed by の to modify a following noun: {同種|どうしゅ}の〜 ('the same kind of ~').

USAGE:
Register is neutral to slightly formal. Appears in scientific, legal, and journalistic writing. In everyday conversation, {同|おな}じ{種類|しゅるい}の〜 ('the same type of ~') is often more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同種|どうしゅ}の{動物|どうぶつ}: animals of the same species
- {同種|どうしゅ}の{事件|じけん}: a similar incident; the same type of case
- {同種|どうしゅ}の{犯罪|はんざい}: a similar crime
- {同種|どうしゅ}の{商品|しょうひん}: the same kind of product
- {同種|どうしゅ}の{被害|ひがい}: similar damage / harm
- {同種|どうしゅ}の{業務|ぎょうむ}: the same type of work
- {同種|どうしゅ}{業界|ぎょうかい}: the same industry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同|おな}じ{種類|しゅるい}: the same type — plain, conversational equivalent
- {同様|どうよう}: similar; the same — broader; 'the same as'
- {同類|どうるい}: the same category; kindred — often of people (can have a disparaging tone, like 'birds of a feather')
- {類似|るいじ}: similarity; resemblance — similar but not necessarily the same
- {異種|いしゅ}: different kind / species — opposite
- {同種類|どうしゅるい}: the same kind — fuller, somewhat redundant variant
